description.text: This resolution honors the service and sacrifice of U.S. Army Specialist Sarah Beckstrom and U.S. Air Force Staff Sergeant Andrew Wolfe as members of the West Virginia National Guard and extends sympathy, gratitude, and support for their families in the wake of the attack on November 26, 2025, in Washington, DC. The resolution also honors the bravery of the other National Guard members on the scene, expresses gratitude for the action of first responders and National Guard members, and condemns the attack.

latestAction.text: Submitted in the Senate, considered, and agreed to without amendment and with a preamble by Unanimous Consent. (consideration: CR S8580; text: CR S8579)

bill.title: A resolution honoring the service and sacrifice of United States Army Specialist Sarah Beckstrom and United States Air Force Staff Sergeant Andrew Wolfe, who were tragically shot in Washington, D.C., in a targeted assault against United States service members on November 26, 2025.

aiDescription.summary: This Senate resolution honors Specialist Sarah Beckstrom and Staff Sergeant Andrew Wolfe, condemns the November 26, 2025 targeted shooting in Washington, D.C., and expresses sympathy and gratitude to their families and first responders. It honors both West Virginia National Guard members—Beckstrom (deceased) and Wolfe (critically injured)—and their fellow Guardsmen.

impact.summary:
This Senate resolution honors Specialist Sarah Beckstrom and Staff Sergeant Andrew Wolfe, West Virginia National Guard members shot during the November 26, 2025 Washington, D.C. attack, and expresses sympathy to their families.  
It honors fellow West Virginia National Guard members, first responders, condemns the attack.
